argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$o=[ordered]@{action='isolated_headless_browser'}
$chrome='C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe'
$profile='E:\PC-Control\AvitoDirectChrome-20261012\Profile'
$port=17447
if(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $chrome -PathType Leaf)){throw 'CHROME_EXE_MISSING'}
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $profile){$o.status='ABORT_PROFILE_ALREADY_EXISTS';$o|ConvertTo-Json -Compress;exit 0}
$inuse=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
if($inuse.Count -gt 0){$o.status='ABORT_PORT_IN_USE';$o|ConvertTo-Json -Compress;exit 0}
$parent=Split-Path $profile -Parent
[System.IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($parent)|Out-Null
$args=@('--headless=new','--remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1',"--remote-debugging-port=$port","--user-data-dir=$profile",'--no-proxy-server','--no-first-run','--no-default-browser-check','--disable-background-networking','https://www.avito.ru/')
$p=Start-Process -FilePath $chrome -ArgumentList $args -PassThru
$o.pid=$p.Id;$o.profileDedicated=$true;$o.port=$port;$o.explicitNoProxy=$true;$o.primaryChromeUnmodified=$true
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
try{$v=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:'+ $port +'/json/version') -TimeoutSec 3;$o.cdpReady=$true;$o.browser=$v.Browser;$o.status='STARTED'}catch{$o.cdpReady=$false;$o.status='STARTED_CDP_UNAVAILABLE'}
$o|ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 4
